title: Battle of Kanōguchi
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kanōguchi", at revision 1370444741, opens: "The Battle of Kanōguchi  was a battle during the Sengoku period of Japan. 
As part of the very long rivalry between Oda Nobuhide and Saitō Dōsan, along with Dōsan's defense of his position in Mino Province." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871383, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1544 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
